question:
In Speculative Decoding Architectures, what failure mode triggers the following observed symptom?
"Edge case trigger: 'Root Cause'"

options.text: When speculative tokens are rejected, the engine must roll back the target model's KV cache pointers to erase the rejected tokens. Failing to decrement the sequence length in the block manager leaves phantom tokens in the attention cache.
The draft model proposes its next batch of tokens from a stale copy of the KV cache taken before the previous rejection was rolled back, reintroducing the same rejected tokens.
The block manager returns a rejected token's physical block to the free pool immediately, before the scheduler finishes writing the corrected token into that slot.
The target model verifies draft tokens in a separate forward pass per position instead of a single batched pass, so verification is correct but far slower than expected.

explanation: Diagnostic Analysis: When speculative tokens are rejected, the engine must roll back the target model's KV cache pointers to erase the rejected tokens. Failing to decrement the sequence length in the block manager leaves phantom tokens in the attention cache.
